title: Optimal enforcement of natural conditions on smooth boundaries with piecewise polynomials upon fitted straight-edged meshes
summary: A few decades ago some possible remedies to an inaccurate enforcement of Neumann or Robin conditions prescribed on the boundary of a smooth domain, owing to its approximation by the union of straight-edged triangles or tetrahedra in a fitted mesh, were addressed.
